**Tier 12.** Its `application`, `domain` and
`infrastructure` may import only a strictly lower tier. `http/` composes freely
but may never reach into another module's `http/` or `infrastructure/`.

May import: `account`, `activity`, `auth`, `cart`, `catalog`, `chat`, `checkout`, `commerce`, `contact`, `customers`, `delivery`, `gift`, `identity`, `invoicing`, `loyalty`, `messaging`, `orders`, `payments`, `plugins`, `seo`, `settings`, `settlement`, `shipping`, `vintedReviews`, `vouchers`.

Currently imports: `activity`, `catalog`, `commerce`, `customers`, `delivery`, `identity`, `messaging`, `orders`, `payments`, `plugins`, `settings`, `shipping`.

Feature map entry: `operations` in [tuucho/docs/features.json](../../../../../docs/features.json). Run `npm run feature -- operations` for its full span.
